author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes:
Test build 1.7.0. Installs alongside the release version; your existing install is untouched. RESCAN REQUIRED - the rule-link data model changed.

RULE LINKS: recognises two more Rule Machine storage forms seen in community testing - ruleActMain (an alternate Run Actions target) and privateF (an alternate Private Boolean target). A rule using either was previously invisible to the graph.

RENAMED for accuracy: the 'Stops' relationship is now 'Cancel timed actions', matching what the action actually does (cancels a pending Wait/Delay, not a running process). 'Pauses' is now 'Pause/resume', since the two cannot yet be told apart on this hub.

INSIGHTS: a new 'Broken rule references' section lists any rule/action/pause/private-boolean target that no longer resolves to anything, and which apps still reference it.

Reports welcome on the community thread.
